title: Power BooK IV: Force's Gabrielle Ryan Name Drops The Shade Room In Episode One
htmlContent:
Power Book IV: Force premiered on Sunday morning at midnight, and within the first ten minutes, The Shade Room was mentioned by Gloria. She meets Tommy Egan for the first time.

Gloria is described as a "sharp-shaver and gorgeous former Marine" seeking to create her own way to Chicago. It has a bar where it concocts Michelin dishes, inspired by Jamaica, and dreams of owning its own restaurant someday. But a bunch of Irish mobsters looking to move into his territory could threaten this. Her chance encounter with Tommy will soon destroy her world, over which she alone can take control.

As for The Shade Room, If you are not familiar with what it is. It's one of the most popular Urban sites on the internet. It is an Instagram-based media outlet for gossip and up-to-date news from the mainstream to the Urban culture.

The company was founded by Angelica Nwandu in March 2014.
